Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.utils

Class Observable<Event extends Enum<Event>,Representation>

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.utils.Observable<Event,Representation>
Type Parameters:
Event - the events' Enum used to represent events.
Representation - the representation used for the observable.
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClientExceptionsNotifierImpl, ModelImpl, PlayerChat, View
public class Observable<Event extends Enum<Event>,Representation> extends Object
Observable Class used for Observer/Observable pattern. It has a boolean attribute "changed" to indicate when changes have occurred, and a vector of observers.
